title: Location market signal snapshot v1
description: One row per canonical location: rolling text-mentioned social activity plus latest known source supply at build time. Not measured demand or a historical supply-at-date reconstruction. Unresolved venues are build-level quality evidence only. The Delta table is fully replaced; no snapshot history.

snapshot_date.description: Deterministic analysis reference date, equal to window_end_date; not a historical supply date.

window_end_date.description: Inclusive social window end; maximum input social activity date unless explicitly overridden.

social_post_count.description: Sum of Gold daily post_count within the inclusive window; zero where social evidence is absent. Mentioned-place activity signal, not measured demand.

social_like_count.description: Sum of Gold daily like_count within the inclusive window; zero where social evidence is absent. Mentioned-place activity signal, not measured demand.

social_reply_count.description: Sum of Gold daily reply_count within the inclusive window; zero where social evidence is absent. Mentioned-place activity signal, not measured demand.

social_repost_count.description: Sum of Gold daily repost_count within the inclusive window; zero where social evidence is absent. Mentioned-place activity signal, not measured demand.

social_quote_count.description: Sum of Gold daily quote_count within the inclusive window; zero where social evidence is absent. Mentioned-place activity signal, not measured demand.

social_engagement_total.description: Sum of Gold daily engagement_total within the inclusive window; zero where social evidence is absent. Mentioned-place activity signal, not measured demand.

venue_count.description: Latest known source venues; null when supply evidence is absent. PBPlus/source-specific, not complete national supply.

known_court_count.description: Sum of explicitly known court counts; null when all counts are unknown or supply is absent. Never coalesced to zero.

venues_with_known_court_count.description: Venues with an explicit court count, including known zero counts; null when supply is absent.

venues_without_known_court_count.description: Venues whose court counts are unknown; null when supply is absent.

court_count_coverage_ratio.description: venues_with_known_court_count / venue_count when positive; otherwise null. Court-count data coverage, not market completeness or location resolution.

has_social_signal.description: Whether this side has an input location row (social restricted to the selected window).

has_supply_signal.description: Whether this side has an input location row (social restricted to the selected window).

social_activity_per_venue.description: social_post_count / venue_count when positive; otherwise null. Descriptive source-specific ratio, not a demand/gap score.

social_engagement_per_venue.description: social_engagement_total / venue_count when positive; otherwise null. Descriptive source-specific ratio, not a demand/gap score.
